observation: Clean artifact progression: design→critique→revision→red→green→review with zero rework. Critique findings (7 warnings) folded into plan before builder started. All 45 tests green on first run.

Single-file scope perfectly bounded: only WorkTeam.tsx touched in production. No scope creep, no unrelated edits. Changes scoped by design (4-tile swap, wrapper composition). Reviewable in ~20 minutes.

Design freeze at Phase-1 lock held firm. Variant B locked at 4a3f4ad5; no reopening during critique/architecture. Allowed review to focus on 'did plan realize design?' not 'should we reconsider design?' Faster iteration.
TDD forced AC precision. 912 lines of tests written before implementation. All 45 tests (10 E2E + 35 component) passed on first run. Red phase eliminated mid-implementation surprises.

Lore documentation at decision points. 5 @lore comments in implementation explain design rationale: flex-wrap (AQ-108 mitigation), 4-tile mandatory, empty-Status derivation, tile sizing rule. Decisions anchored to code, not folklore.

Multi-agent critique surfaced different risk classes: design-critique caught hierarchy/UX/empty-state gaps; architecture-critique caught implementation-path/testid/scope gaps. Neither alone sufficient. Both folded back to plan before code.

Cost-signal: 912 lines tests, ~200 lines implementation. Test/code ratio 4.6:1. High but justified (E2E matrix × 3 viewports, state branches). No rework or re-critique loops. Estimated ~130k tokens + ~4-5 hours saved vs iterate-without-plan approach.

Phase-2 critique warnings resolved before builder received plan: testid split (Tier-1/2) documented, screenshot path corrected (test-results/), empty-team Status defined (—/No agents), 4-tile locked, 3-tile fallback downgraded to emergency-only. All 7 items folded in revision commit (9f36037f).

Playwright E2E matrix strategy proves AC-1/2/3/4 at 3 widths (1280/2000/2560) × 2 states (populated/empty). Total 10 expanded cases from 6 test() decls. Component tests cover wrapper structure, StatTile render, Status derivation, testid Tier-1/2 preservation. Coverage is exhaustive for single-file change.

L13 E2E flake on getByText('HyperIdle Core') persists but is pre-existing (reproduces on base commit 4a3f4ad5). Not an AG1 regression. The /api/teams/:id page-route mock may be stale or mismatched. Requires L13-specific triage outside AG1 scope.
